While the forecast captures a 90% probability range, certain high-impact, low-probability events could push the actual outcome beyond these stated intervals. Such "tail risks" might include unforeseen major geopolitical conflicts that disrupt global markets or supply chains, a sudden and severe economic downturn or boom, significant technological disruptions that fundamentally alter the landscape related to this metric, or drastic and unexpected regulatory changes. These are events not typically factored into the standard probabilistic modeling of daily or monthly fluctuations, and their occurrence could lead to deviations far outside the expected 90% confidence boundaries, highlighting the inherent unpredictability of extreme events.
